svg.title: Level 2 overlay - Water Service
svg.desc: Water Service layer based on official Rijkswaterstaat NWB Vaarwegen route geometry, aligned to the Level 1 Netherlands SVG.
svg.metadata: Source: PDOK / Rijkswaterstaat NWB - Vaarwegen OGC API, collection vaarwegvakken, CC0 1.0. Coordinates transformed from CRS84 lon/lat to this deck's 1600x900 Level 1 SVG viewBox.
